source: USA Baseball American Development Model (Activate/Discover stages) + Youth Baseball Skills Matrix's Daily Practice Organization Outline + this app's own data/pitch-smart-rules.json. T-Ball and Rookies/Coach-Pitch content is adapted from Little League University's official diagrammed curricula (littleleague.org/downloads/tee-ball-program, littleleague.org/downloads/coach-pitch-12-week-program). Minors content is assembled from ADM + the Skills Matrix. Majors content has no official published curriculum anywhere (Little League's own site confirms the gap) -- those drills are sourceType 'lybs-original' and need LYBS coach review before being treated as settled.
note: Flat, atomic drill library -- a coach picks individual drills and builds their own practice, rather than adopting a pre-made weekly plan. Each drill is tagged with a 'tier' (foundational/standard/advanced) WITHIN its division: foundational is what a player new to that level needs, advanced is a stretch for players already ahead, standard is the typical mid-season expectation. Tier lives on the drill, not the team -- this app's roster has no field for a player's prior experience, so a coach judges their own team's makeup and filters to the tier(s) that fit (e.g. a team with a few new-to-Majors players and some returners might want Foundational + Standard visible together). 'category' values are drawn from data/skill-benchmarks-seed.json's own category vocabulary, plus 'Game/Scrimmage' and 'Multi-Station' for closing activities and multi-coach station rotations. Phase 1 -- migrated from the prior pre-built-practice version, not a full buildout.
